Permeable_Mucosal_Skin.description: A highly porous, glandular skin that must remain moist. It allows exact oxygen exchange underwater (cutaneous respiration), allowing the entity to breathe indefinitely while submerged, though it dries and cracks painfully in arid environments.

Granular_Toxin_Cuticle.description: Thick, leathery skin dotted with prominent parotoid glands. When physically struck, these granular warts rupture, violently secreting a milky, highly virulent bufotoxin that poisons and burns any attacker attempting to grapple or bite.

Aposematic_Poison_Dermis.description: Brilliantly colored, high-contrast skin completely unsuited for camouflage. Its neon hues serve as a stark biological warning: even the slightest dermal contact with the batrachotoxin-laced slime can induce instant paralysis in predators.
